bookings_pay_by_check.name: bookings_pay_by_check
bookings_pay_by_check.value: status <> 'awaiting-payment' OR pay_by IS NOT NULL

bookings_accepted_at_check.name: bookings_accepted_at_check
bookings_accepted_at_check.value: status <> 'awaiting-payment' OR accepted_at IS NOT NULL

messages_content_check.name: messages_content_check
messages_content_check.value: (kind = 'text' AND body IS NOT NULL AND body <> '' AND photo_key IS NULL AND card IS NULL) OR (kind = 'photo' AND photo_key IS NOT NULL AND body IS NULL AND card IS NULL) OR (kind = 'card' AND card IS NOT NULL AND body IS NULL AND photo_key IS NULL)

disputes_opened_by_needed_check.name: disputes_opened_by_needed_check
disputes_opened_by_needed_check.value: reason not in ('problem','no-show-objection') OR opened_by IS NOT NULL

disputes_decided_check.name: disputes_decided_check
disputes_decided_check.value: (decision IS NULL AND decided_at IS NULL AND decision_reason IS NULL AND provider_share IS NULL) OR (decision IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND decision_reason IS NOT NULL AND provider_share IS NOT NULL)
